description: This Java source file defines a Spring configuration class 'JPAConfig' that sets up JPA (Java Persistence API) related configurations for the application, including entity manager factory, vendor properties, package scanning, and auditing.

classes.name: JPAConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class for setting up JPA, including entity manager factory, vendor properties, package scanning, and auditing.

methods.name: entityManagerFactory
methods.description: Creates and configures the EntityManagerFactory bean with data source, vendor properties, and package scanning.

methods.name: getVendorProperties
methods.description: Returns vendor-specific JPA properties, including weaving, cache, and persistence context settings.

methods.name: getPackagesToScan
methods.description: Determines the list of packages to scan for JPA entities, including additional packages from customizers.

methods.name: entityManagerFactoryBuilder
methods.description: Builds the EntityManagerFactoryBuilder with custom persistence unit post-processors.

methods.name: getPersistenceUnitPostProcessors
methods.description: Provides post-processors for persistence units, including database selection logic.

methods.name: createJpaVendorAdapter
methods.description: Creates the JPA vendor adapter, specifically EclipseLink in this configuration.
